sourceAnchors.claim: GetOrBuildReportBuilder parses the descriptor with AxisMap and applies ButtonMap plus TriggerButtons.
USB profiles without armOn or alwaysArmed do not allocate or arm the extended encoder.
SubmitState selects the legacy builder, then publishes report[1..64] as 63 data bytes.
The descriptor parser selects report ID 1 and computes 504 data bits.
The active encoder clears the report, truncates and clamps axes, maps the hat, derives digital trigger buttons, and applies ButtonMap.
WriteInputFrame copies exactly dataLen bytes starting at dataOffset.
The profile's inputReportSize 64 is written as InputReportByteLength.
The driver zero-fills, prepends report ID 1, overlays at most 63 data bytes, and delivers expectedSize 64.
